contexts.text: Concerning more interior things. SE 680. SE 1214.
Concerning Spirits who do not want to hear the interior and more interior things of the Word. SE 1140.
They cannot tolerate the more interior things; but desire to remain solely in interior ones. SE 1179. SE 1180.
When interior and more interior things favour their cupidities...
The cuticular ones are averse to interior and more interior things.
There is a mind still interior, or more interior...
Concerning the more interior and inmost things of the Word.
Concerning the inscrutability of inmost and more interior things.
That the inmost and more interior things of man cannot be injured, but only his interior things.
How much more the more interior things which inflow into the interior ones.
